purpose: Teach: 出撃/前途/可否/押え/広義/互角/前段/奔走

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、機動隊が出撃される場面もありますね
lines.en: There are scenes where the police and riot units are deployed.
lines.style: Observant and impressed. Measured pace. Slight nod of respect in the voice. Warm acknowledgment of what he's learned about their work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、若手警官の前途を支援されてますね
lines.en: You really do support young officers in their careers, don't you.
lines.style: Gentle inquiry, genuinely curious. Steady tone. Not quite a question, not quite a statement—he's drawing out what he's noticed about their commitment to mentorship.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場捜査の可否を判断されますね
lines.en: You make judgments about what's possible at each crime scene.
lines.style: Thoughtful, recognizing the weight of discretion. Slight hesitation before the main clause—acknowledging this isn't simple. Steady and serious.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、暴動を押え込む技術を磨かれてますね
lines.en: You're constantly refining your techniques for controlling riots.
lines.style: Impressed but matter-of-fact. Acknowledging the skill without theatrics. Even pace. Slight emphasis on 'constantly'—recognizing ongoing dedication.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、広義のサイバー犯罪にも対応されますね
lines.en: You respond to cybercrime in all its forms.
lines.style: Admiring the breadth of it. Brisk, clear tone. Not dwelling—just laying out what he's come to understand about their scope.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪組織と互角の捜査力をお持ちですね
lines.en: You have investigative capability that matches organized crime itself.
lines.style: Clear admiration. Firm delivery on the comparison. Slower pace—this is significant. Slight pause before 'organized crime,' letting the weight land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、報告書の前段で要旨を示されますね
lines.en: You summarize the key points before the detailed report.
lines.style: Noting a procedural detail with quiet appreciation. Matter-of-fact tone. Efficient—no wasted words. Recognizing smart system design.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、夜間も奔走されておられますね
lines.en: You're out there working through the night as well.
lines.style: Warm, personal note of recognition. Slight softening toward the end. Not pitying—acknowledging the commitment. Closer, more intimate than the earlier lines.
